description.0: I’m <serif>Aymaan Shaikh</serif> — a developer obsessed with using AI + “big data” to solve real, high-impact problems.
description.1: I’ve worked across cloud infrastructure, applied ML, and <url5><serif>AI research</serif></url5> — touching everything from <url6><serif>finance</serif></url6> and med-ML to <url7><serif>telecom</serif></url7>, quant trading, AI agents/bots, social good, and a handful of startups — from production systems to experimentation-heavy labs. Along the way, I’ve done a few fellowships, founded a nonprofit, and I’m big on volunteering and giving back.
description.2: On campus, I’m the founder/president of <url8><serif>Cornell’s Billiards Club</serif></url8> — my favorite way to train precision and accuracy. I’ve also been a course assistant for technical classes and a CS mentor.
description.3: Outside the screen: 🧗 rock climbing and 🎾 tennis, with a side of 🏸 badminton and ⚽ soccer.
description.4: Now I’m focused on building in AI — the kind of work that ships, scales, and actually matters.

1.description: When I thought about a simple concept or a complex invention, I could always see myself using my idea in my daily life. However, I wanted to bring my imagination to reality. Welcome to the world of 3D Modeling. In this digital realm, I'm able to take my crazy breakthroughs and visualize them through a 3D scale. Then, through the power of 3D printing, I'm able to push the digital to the physical.
